verdicts.reason: A: the date card shrinks to an unreadable speck, so SAT 22 NOV and the times are gone. The decorative pattern strip is blown up into a huge hero block, the controller is reduced to a tiny icon at the bottom, and the eyebrow line sits under the CTA, which breaks reading order. B: the date card is also shrunk until it can't be read, and the body copy is squeezed into a narrow column that wraps badly ('Pier 9 / Arcade: / 40 retro…'). The pattern strip is cramped and doesn't reach the bottom-right edge. Still, B keeps the eyebrow → logo → headline → controller → CTA order and gives the controller a real presence, so it is the less broken of the two.
